result:
T-DG2-BE7 is finished: `name` and `reason` now reject invisible-only text with `validation.blank`, and both inline reason parsers use the shared schema. Every required check passed, except that the standard `pnpm format:check` exits 2 because the sandbox blocks it from reading 12 dotfiles. The `--ignore-path` variant you allowed for that case passes. The changes are uncommitted and the handback is at `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG2/T-DG2-BE7-backend-workflow-engineer.md`.

- **Shared schemas:** in `packages/shared/src/schemas/common.ts`, `name` (1–200) and `reason` (3–1000) still trim and still enforce min/max. They now also reject values with no visible content, such as `"‏‏‏"`, `"⁠⁠⁠"` and `"\u0085\u0085\u0085"`, with `validation.blank`. `"   "` still fails `too_small` only. They are defined after `hasVisibleContent` and `BLANK_TEXT_CODE`, so there is no TDZ error.
- **One difference from the assignment wording:** I didn't copy `freeText`'s `v.length === 0` guard exactly. For `reason` (min 3), that guard would give a single `"‏"` two errors, because zod keeps running the check after `min` fails. I used `v.length < min`, which is the same for `name` and gives exactly one error in every case.
- **Inline parsers:** the register archive and evidence-link removal endpoints now use the shared `reasonRequest`. The authorization check, If-Match/409 and the audit event are unchanged.
- **Sweep:** two more places decided "blank" with `trim()`, and I moved both onto the shared rule:
  - the admin identity `issuer` check, which keeps the same 400 at `/identity/issuer`;
  - the OIDC display-name claim, where an invisible-only name now falls back to the email.

  Three other `trim()` hits only tidy text that has already passed the visibility check, so I left them alone. The handback's sweep table lists every hit.
- **Tests:**
  - 7 shared unit tests.
  - 3 new integration tests in `blank-text.test.ts`: TOM gap archive, evidence-link removal and P1 transformation archive. Each checks the 400 at `/reason`, that nothing is written and that no audit row is added, then that a valid reason still succeeds.
  - Integration coverage for the issuer and OIDC changes.

  I put the old code back temporarily and all the new tests failed on it. Then I restored the fix.
- **ADR-0017 §2:** now says `name` and `reason` follow the same visible-content rule, citing F-DG2-160.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `pnpm -r typecheck`, `pnpm -r build`, `pnpm lint` | all exit 0 |
| `pnpm format:check` | exit 2: only the 12 dotfiles the sandbox blocks |
| `prettier --check --ignore-path` variant | exit 0 |
| `pnpm openapi:lint` | exit 0, 161 operations |
| `pnpm test`, Node 22 and Node 24 | 558/558 on each |
| Integration suite on a disposable PostgreSQL 16.13 (port 55471) | 465/465; `blank-text` 20/20; `contract` 11/11 with 161 operations |
| `validate.mjs --historical --stage DG1` | exit 0 |

No migrations or new endpoints. `openapi.yaml`, migrations 0010–0019 and `apps/web/**` are untouched.

Three gaps remain, all in the handback:
- `freeText` with a minimum above 1 (for example the gate rationale, min 3) can still give an invisible value shorter than the minimum two errors. It was outside this task's scope, and nothing invalid gets accepted.
- A reason saved before this fix with only invisible characters would no longer match the response schema. No such data exists in the seed or tests, and nothing is deployed.
- FE5 should confirm that web forms show the Arabic and English message for `validation.blank` on name and reason fields.
